_comment: ✅ DESIGN §9.3: v0 has five of the seven major posts — treasury, garrison, works, granary, market. Temple and tribal relations wait for their versions. Change this file, not code.

posts.name: Treasurer
posts.description: Guards the denarii. Lowers corruption when held by a disciplined man of your own house.

posts.name: Prefect of the garrison
posts.description: Commands the militia. His discipline adds to the walls.

posts.name: Curator of works
posts.description: Oversees construction. His craft shortens build times.

posts.name: Prefect of the granary
posts.description: Manages the fields and the granary. His craft raises grain yields.

posts.name: Aedile of the market
posts.description: Runs the market. His connections raise denarii income.
